title: Pointer to the properties of [def-trf-admissibility]
text:
In the notation of [def-trf-admissibility], the following holds. Of the ambient
exceptional right adjoint datum of
[def-weil-ambient-exceptional-adjoint] — clause (1) of
[def-weil-exceptional-adjoint-admissibility] — *both halves are
theorems* for a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes on
the bounded constructible and finite-Tor categories, by
[cor-sf-ambient-adjoint-discharge].
